The 12 `input` commands of the editor at engine `319075e3f92b`: each with its description, its kind, the MCP toolsets that offer it, its parameters and their JSON Schema (the other groups have files of their own).

## input.action

Holds an input action of the running game (play mode) directly, whatever its bindings, as if a player used its controls: scripts see it through Input:\:IsActionDown/IsActionPressed/IsActionReleased and GetActionValue, and the game UI navigates with the UI map's (UI/Submit, UI/Cancel, UI/Up...). tap (default) holds it for 'steps' fixed steps of the game (or 'seconds' of game time), press until a release (or input.releaseAll, play.stop), release ends its hold. An action has one hold: a new tap or press replaces the one before (ending it, interrupted when it was a tap) without letting the action go. value: an Axis' \[x, 0\] (default \[1, 0\]), a Vector2's \[x, y\] (required, length at most 1); a Button takes none. The game still reads it as up while its map is disabled or a binding capture listens. Keys given with input.key reach actions through their bindings instead. Answers once the game has seen the input (a tap: its release), or at once with wait false (the default while paused). Returns action (its qualified name), kind, mode, value, seen, and what is still held.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `play` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputCommands.cpp:761`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string | yes |   | The action: &quot;&lt;Map&gt;/&lt;Action&gt;&quot;, or its bare name when no other map has an action so named (input.state lists them). |
| `frames` | integer | no |   | Same as steps (an older name: they used to count frames). Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `mode` | string | no |   | tap (default): hold the action for 'steps' fixed steps of the game (or 'seconds' of game time), then let go; press: hold it until a release, input.releaseAll or play.stop; release: end its hold (a tap's too). One of: `tap`, `press`, `release`. |
| `seconds` | number | no |   | Game time a tap lasts, rounded up to whole fixed steps of the scene's step (scene.info's settings.fixedRate.fixedTimestep; instead of steps). |
| `steps` | integer | no |   | Fixed steps of the game a tap lasts (default 1). Exact when frames run one step each (play.step, input.sequence); in a running game the release lands after the frame whose update ran the last step, which may run up to the scene's maxFixedSteps - 1 more. Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `value` | array of number | no |   | The action's value while held: an Axis' \[x, 0\] (x from -1 to 1, default \[1, 0\]), a Vector2's \[x, y\] (required, +Y up, length at most 1); none for a Button or a release. Items: at least 2, at most 2. |
| `wait` | boolean | no |   | Answer once the game has seen the input (default: true while the game runs; false while it is paused without a pending step, because the input then waits for play.step or play.pause false and the command would wait with it). |

## input.click

Clicks a game UI element of the running game (play mode) as a player would: moves the simulated pointer to the center of its rect (at the Game view's size) and taps a mouse button there for 'steps' fixed steps of the game (default 1; or 'seconds'), like input.mouseButton. Fails, changing nothing, when the element is not shown on a canvas that receives input, or when something else is on top of its center (the error names what a click would hit: the menu is covered). Answers once the game has seen the release, with entity, position (in the Game view, as input.mouseMove takes it), steps, clicked (a button clicked or a toggle or slider changed: the selectable the click pressed raised its event) and events (every UI event of the click: type click, valueChanged or focusChanged, widget, name, value, focused); with wait false at once, without clicked and events. In input.sequence it is a command event (run with wait false): the click lands in its step.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `play` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputCommands.cpp:1210`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | string | no |   | The mouse button (default Left; case does not matter). |
| `entity` | string | yes |   | The UI element to click (a button, toggle, slider, or any element whose center is a raycast target) (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `frames` | integer | no |   | Same as steps (an older name: they used to count frames). Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `seconds` | number | no |   | Game time the click's press lasts, rounded up to whole fixed steps of the scene's step (scene.info's settings.fixedRate.fixedTimestep; instead of steps). |
| `steps` | integer | no |   | Fixed steps of the game the click's press lasts (default 1). Exact when frames run one step each (play.step, input.sequence); in a running game the release lands after the frame whose update ran the last step, which may run up to the scene's maxFixedSteps - 1 more. Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `wait` | boolean | no |   | Answer once the game has seen the input (default: true while the game runs; false while it is paused without a pending step, because the input then waits for play.step or play.pause false and the command would wait with it). |

## input.gamepadAxis

Moves a gamepad stick or trigger of the running game (play mode): scripts read the value through Input:\:GetGamepadAxis and GetGamepadStick (sticks -1 to 1 with +x right and +y up, triggers 0 released to 1 pressed; values are clamped to that range), and the gamepad counts as connected until play stops. The value holds for 'steps' fixed steps (or 'seconds' of game time) and then returns to the device's, or without a duration until another input.gamepadAxis of the axis, a value of null (back to the device's at once), input.releaseAll or play.stop. A new value of the axis replaces the one before. Answers once the game has seen it (with a duration: its return), or at once with wait false (the default while paused).

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `play` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputCommands.cpp:960`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | string | yes |   | The axis, named like the SDK's GamepadAxis:: constants (case does not matter): LeftX, LeftY, RightX, RightY, LeftTrigger, RightTrigger. |
| `frames` | integer | no |   | Same as steps (an older name: they used to count frames). Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `gamepad` | integer | no |   | The gamepad, 0 to 3 (default 0): scripts read it as gamepad index; a gamepad simulated input used counts as connected until play stops. Value: at least `0`, at most `3`. |
| `seconds` | number | no |   | Game time the value lasts, rounded up to whole fixed steps of the scene's step (scene.info's settings.fixedRate.fixedTimestep; instead of steps). |
| `steps` | integer | no |   | Fixed steps of the game the value lasts (default: until replaced or released). Exact when frames run one step each (play.step, input.sequence); in a running game the release lands after the frame whose update ran the last step, which may run up to the scene's maxFixedSteps - 1 more. Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `value` | number or null | yes |   | The axis' value (sticks -1 to 1, triggers 0 to 1), or null to give the axis back to the device. |
| `wait` | boolean | no |   | Answer once the game has seen the input (default: true while the game runs; false while it is paused without a pending step, because the input then waits for play.step or play.pause false and the command would wait with it). |

## input.gamepadButton

Presses a gamepad button for the running game (play mode), like input.key: scripts see it through Input:\:IsGamepadButtonDown/Pressed/Released, and the gamepad counts as connected (Input:\:IsGamepadConnected) from then until play stops, with or without a device. tap (default) holds it for 'steps' fixed steps (or 'seconds'), press until a release; answers once the game has seen it, or at once with wait false (the default while paused). Returns the gamepad, the button, seen, and what is still held.

## input.key

Presses a key for the running game (play mode), as if a player did: scripts see it through Input:\:IsKeyDown/IsKeyPressed/IsKeyReleased, also while the viewport has no focus. tap (default) holds the key for 'steps' fixed steps of the game (or 'seconds' of game time), press holds it until a release (or input.releaseAll, play.stop), release ends every hold of the key. Each command ends only its own hold: overlapping taps of one key keep it down until the last ends. Steps are the game's own time base, so a tap lasts the same game time whatever the frame rate, and input given while the game is paused reaches it in the next step play.step runs or after play.pause false. Answers once the game has seen the input (a tap: its release), or at once with wait false (the default while paused). Returns the key, seen, and the keys and buttons still held.

## input.releaseAll

Ends every hold of simulated input in the running game (play mode): held keys, mouse buttons, gamepad buttons and input actions go up and held gamepad axes return to the device's values in the game's next frame, unfinished taps end there (their commands answer with interrupted true), and presses still waiting for a game frame are dropped. Answers once the game has seen it, or at once with wait false (the default while paused), with what was released.

## input.sequence

Plays a script of input in the running game, timed in its fixed steps (play mode): pauses the game (and resumes it at the end if it ran), then every frame runs exactly one step with the events of that step, so the result is the same whatever the frame rate. events: \[{step (0-based, below steps), then one of: key \| mouseButton \| gamepadButton (+ gamepad) with action press \| release \| tap (+ steps, a tap's length); gamepadAxis (+ gamepad) with value (null: back to the device); mouseMove \[x, y\]; scroll \[x, y\]; action (an input action, as input.action takes it) with mode press \| release \| tap (+ steps) and value; command (an input.\* command, run with wait: false; its parameters checked against its schema before anything runs) with parameters}\]; events of one step apply in order, and one that fails ends the sequence with its error (holds released, the game resumed if it ran). steps: fixed steps to run (at least the last event's step + 1). observe: \[{entity, component, property?}, {entity, script (class), field}, {entity, world: true}\], each with every (sample after every n steps; default only at the end). The sequence's holds are released at its end unless keepHeld. Answers once it ran: {stepsRun, frameIndex, time, seen: \[{step, event (index)}\], samples: \[{step, values: \[{observe (index), value}\]}\], interrupted (a tap of it was ended by something else)}; play stopping or resuming fails it with stepsRun. play.step and another input.sequence fail while it runs. wait: false answers at once with {sequence, steps}.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `play` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputCommands.cpp:679`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `events` | array of object | yes |   | Input events, each with its step. |
| `keepHeld` | boolean | no |   | Keep the keys and buttons the sequence still holds at its end (default false: released). |
| `observe` | array of object | no |   | What to sample: {entity, component, property?, every?}, {entity, script, field, every?} or {entity, world: true, every?}. |
| `steps` | integer | yes |   | Fixed steps to run. Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `wait` | boolean | no |   | Answer once the sequence ran (default true). |

## input.state

Simulated input in the running game: the keys, mouse buttons and gamepad buttons the input.\* commands hold, the gamepad axes they hold with their values, the input actions input.action holds with theirs (simulatedActions), the gamepads simulated input connected (gamepads), the pointer position the game sees (null until input.mouseMove), whether the game is paused so input waits for its next frame (paused), whether input is waiting for that frame (queued), every hold with the fixed steps it covers (holds: \[{type, name, firstStep, lastStep (null until released)}\]), the game's fixed steps so far (fixedSteps) and whether an input.sequence runs (sequenceRunning). Device input (a person at the keyboard) is not included in those. The game's input actions as it reads them now (actions: \[{action, map, kind, down, value}\], device input included), the maps' enables (maps: \[{map, enabled}\]), the players' bindings that replace the project's (playerBindings: {action: \[bindings\]}, see inputActions.resetPlayerBindings) and whether a binding capture listens (capture: every action reads as up meanwhile).

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Session` · MCP toolsets: `play` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputCommands.cpp:1060`

No parameters.

```json
}
```
